The gate agent raised a question about staff rotas after reading your complaint, and we understand that your concern is about how your companion animal was handled during the journey and how the service felt inconsistent. We are sorry that the experience left you frustrated, and we have reviewed the report with the desk team and the safety coordinator so that the handling notes, service changes, and handoff points are checked against procedure. Where a passenger raises a concern, supervisors are expected to listen carefully and make sure the record is complete, since dependable companion travel depends on clear communication at every stage.

<<FACT F120>>

The matter has been logged for follow-up through the service record, and the team will review whether any step in the process was missed or poorly communicated. We cannot undo the upset you experienced, but we can confirm that your complaint has been passed to the appropriate staff for review of the staffing pattern, the care notes, and the transfer of responsibility between teams. Aurelia Skyways expects the Companion Animal Travel Desk to keep companion travel dependable, and that includes responding promptly when a traveler says the service fell short. If further details are needed to complete the review, the desk will contact you through the usual channel, and the file will remain open until that check is done.

We appreciate you bringing this to our attention, because complaints of this kind help us strengthen the way we support travelers and their animals. The Companion Animal Travel Desk
